messages:
olivia: quick follow-up from the postmortem \u2014 same failure mode repeated across three rollouts when batch workers ramped. sketching concrete actions.
raj: list please. the ramp timing seems correlated with job windows.
olivia: TL;DR: enrich flag metadata, add dependency checks, stricter holdback curves, auto-rollback with blast-radius caps, signal tagging, and a recurrence detector.
marcus: propose default holdback curve: 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% with 10m windows. slower surface area.
sara: auto-rollback trigger idea: error_rate > 1.5% over 5m AND min_requests > 500 -> rollback step. cap automated change to <=10% traffic. manual kill switch in console with slack confirmation.
lina_pm: need owners and dates so PM can track in remediation board.
olivia: suggested owners/dates: flag-metadata (raj) EOW; trace/metric tagging (marcus) 2w; rollback engine prototype (sara) 1w; recurrence detector POC (olivia + eng-sre) 3w.
raj: will add dependencies[] and risk_level to flag schema and file GH issues.
marcus: will add flag_id and rollout_step into traces and metrics; need eng-sre help for sampling.
eng-sre: can support higher sampling for flagged flows, will coordinate on RF ticket.
sara: prototype will include a simulator to avoid cascading rollbacks across dependent flags. will post design doc tomorrow.
olivia: deploy-bot please create tracking ticket.
deploy-bot: [automated] created RF-1199 "rollout safety: holdback profiles, auto-rollback, dependencies" assigned to raj, marcus, sara, olivia. :white_check_mark:
lina_pm: PM will follow up weekly on RF-1199 and close or reassign items.
raj: will update runbooks with kill-switch steps and the controller pre-checks.
marcus: test plan: synthetic batch harness to validate rollback and ensure no traffic thrash.
sara: prototype includes UI warning for projected blast radius per step and an override audit.
olivia: thanks all. sync Fri 10am. update ticket if reassigning owners. :pray:
